sources.title: MiniMax M2.5 - SOTA in Coding and Agent, Designed for Agent Universe
sources.snippet: By combining reinforcement learning-optimized task decomposition with thinking token efficiency, M2.5 delivers significant advantages in both speed and cost when completing complex tasks. M2.5 is available in 100 TPS and 50 TPS versions, with output pricing at just 1/10 to 1/20 of comparable models.
